sources.name: Federal Reserve Economic Data
sources.operator: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.scope: United States and international macro time series
sources.notes: Current Marco foundation source. Supports broad macro series and FRED-MD style panels.

sources.name: Archival Federal Reserve Economic Data
sources.operator: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.scope: United States real-time/vintage macro time series
sources.notes: Needed for vintage-safe leakage tests and latest-revised vs real-time comparisons.

sources.name: FOMC Statements and Minutes Corpus
sources.operator: vtasca/fed-statement-scraping, derived from Federal Reserve pages
sources.scope: Federal Reserve FOMC statement and minutes text from 2000 onward
sources.notes: Active text-event corpus adapter. Useful for Fed communication features such as hawkish/dovish tone, inflation emphasis, labor-market emphasis, and release-date event joins.

sources.name: IMF Data APIs
sources.scope: Global macro, financial, balance-of-payments, exchange-rate, and IFS datasets
sources.notes: Best global bridge for EM macro panels once the SDMX adapter exists.

sources.name: World Bank Indicators API
sources.notes: Active annual macro controls adapter; current smoke path supports indicator JSON fetches across country baskets.

sources.name: World Bank SDMX WDI
sources.notes: Useful if Marco standardizes on SDMX metadata and structure handling.

sources.name: OECD Data Explorer API
sources.operator: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.notes: Free API with responsible-use/rate-limit expectations; good for standardized cross-country datasets.

sources.name: BIS Statistics SDMX
sources.scope: Global banking, credit, debt securities, property prices, derivatives, and financial statistics
sources.notes: Important for macrofinancial stress, credit cycle, and cross-border banking features.

sources.name: ECB Data Portal
sources.scope: Euro area statistics, exchange rates, inflation, yields, money, balance of payments
sources.notes: First non-FRED structured central-bank adapter; current smoke path supports ECB EXR CSV data such as M.USD.EUR.SP00.A.

sources.name: Bundesbank Statistics API
sources.scope: German and euro-area monetary, financial, exchange-rate, and macro statistics
sources.notes: Useful once the generic SDMX adapter is working.

sources.name: Bank of England Interactive Statistical Database
sources.scope: United Kingdom monetary, financial, exchange-rate, and Bankstats series
sources.notes: Official database supports browsing and downloads; treat as source-specific adapter rather than generic SDMX.

sources.name: Database on Indian Economy
sources.scope: India macro, monetary, banking, finance, and external-sector statistics
sources.notes: Priority EM source. Needs adapter discovery because the public surface is download/UI oriented rather than a simple documented REST API.

sources.name: Banco Central do Brasil SGS
sources.scope: Brazil central-bank time series, exchange rates, reserves, monetary and credit statistics
sources.notes: Strong EM candidate with official open-data resources and SGS JSON/CSV time-series interfaces.

sources.name: Banco de Mexico Economic Information System
sources.scope: Mexico monetary, FX, securities, rates, and central-bank economic statistics
sources.notes: Important EM source; verify API/token posture before implementation.

sources.name: Indonesian Economic and Financial Statistics
sources.scope: Indonesia monetary, government finance, real-sector, and external-sector statistics
sources.notes: Useful EM expansion source after India/Brazil/Mexico; likely source-specific adapter.

sources.name: Bank of Korea Economic Statistics System
sources.notes: Promising source for FRED-MD-style Korea panels; verify API access and terms before implementation.
